_comment: Budgets for scripts/perf_bench.sh runs on the AVD (scripts/emulator.sh, -gpu host). scripts/perf_bench_table.py compares every run to them and lists what is over; with --strict it exits 1. Keys of 'phases' are prefixes of the phase names in test_driver/perf_bench_main.dart; the first matching prefix wins. Values are in ms and sit about 2x above the AVD numbers in docs/PERFORMANCE.md ('AVD before and after'), so noise does not trip them and a real regression does. Lower a budget after a measured improvement; raise one only with a reason in the commit message.

cold_start._comment: Median of the --cold runs. Measured on the AVD 2026-10 (avd-after-2): 1288 ms am TotalTime, 1415 ms to the shell; budget about 2x.

memory._comment: Host RSS of the AVD (qemu) during the run, from _scratch/perf/<label>.rss. Short install peaks are allowed; over the limit for this many seconds in a row is a failure. perf_bench.sh stops the run at the same point.
